Work with people who share your drive to build practical, reliable technology.
  • Production Manager
    Education: Bachelor's degree
    Location: Shanghai
    Experience: 5+ years
    Responsibilities
    1. Manage workshop production to ensure quality and meet production targets.
    2. Oversee the workshop quality system, particularly in addressing on-site anomalies and accelerating response times.
    3. Collaborate with business and engineering teams to support new customer onboarding and prototype builds.
    4. Address process bottlenecks and various on-site issues to ensure smooth production flow, balanced lines, and continuous improvement in quality and efficiency.
    5. Handle workshop staffing, training, role development, and performance management.
    6. Implement on-site management in accordance with ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 standards and 5S requirements, ensuring production safety.
    Requirements
    1. 5+ years of production management experience, including 3+ years in the automotive or electronics industry.
    2. Proficiency in production processes and automotive electronics procedures, with familiarity with the IATF 16949 quality management system.
    3. Knowledgeable in lean management methods such as 5S, SPC, and TPM.
    To apply, call +86-18616602589 or email your résumé to hr@hitelecom.cn

  • Quality Engineer
    Education: Bachelor's degree
    Location: Shanghai
    Experience: 5+ years
    Responsibilities
    1. Prepare work instructions for in-process inspection, final inspection, and process verification.
    2. Handle the verification, review, and disposition of non-conforming products during production, including determining, analyzing, and providing feedback on responsibility for non-conformities.
    3. Conduct quality process audits to monitor production quality and data, investigate issues identified during inspections, analyze and provide feedback, and track corrective actions.
    4. Oversee product quality monitoring, including the production process, finished goods, shipments, defect rates, and analysis and documentation of defects.
    5. Organize relevant departments to investigate, analyze, handle, and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions.
    6. Coordinate with relevant departments to analyze customer complaints, drive improvements, write complaint handling reports, and maintain a customer complaint log.
    7. Communicate with engineering staff to establish inspection standards and specifications, and train and assess inspectors.
    8. Monitor the progress and results of various process trials.
    9. Monitor the quality performance of materials during production and collaborate with SQE to help suppliers continuously improve quality.
    10. Organize and conduct quality meetings weekly to promptly communicate product quality issues and progress on quality improvement projects.
    11. Coordinate second-party audit activities and track the implementation of corrective and preventive measures.
    12. Complete other tasks assigned by management.
    Requirements
    1. Bachelor's degree or higher in a STEM field; experience as a quality internal auditor in the electronics industry preferred.
    2. Proficient with quality analysis tools (the seven basic QC tools and applicable automotive core tools) and familiar with ISO 9001, IATF 16949, and related quality systems.
    3. Strong logical thinking skills, knowledgeable in quality control, quality statistics, and quality management.
    4. Excellent communication skills, team-oriented, detail-oriented, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
    To apply, call +86-18616602589 or email your résumé to hr@hitelecom.cn

  • Test Engineer
    Education: Associate degree or above
    Location: Shanghai
    Experience: 3+ years
    Responsibilities
    1. Establish standards, procedures, plans, and specifications for reliability testing.
    2. Develop product reliability tests, report issues to relevant personnel, and coordinate to ensure progress is communicated to project members.
    3. Read and interpret schematic diagrams and have some soldering experience.
    4. Be able to comprehend component datasheets.
    5. Fully understand and master industry standards and regulations.
    6. Set up testing platforms and use relevant test software and equipment proficiently.
    7. Compile test reports, track and retest faults, assist in the analysis of test anomalies, and review test results.
    8. Use schematic diagrams to troubleshoot and perform basic repairs on circuit boards.
    9. Complete other tasks assigned by management.
    Requirements
    1. Proficient in Microsoft Office.
    2. Strong sense of responsibility and initiative, with excellent communication, coordination, and execution skills, good analytical and problem-solving abilities, and the ability to work under pressure.
    3. A degree in electronics or a related field, with basic knowledge of electronic components and their characteristics and principles.
    4. Experienced with the use of instruments and meters, with over one year of experience in electronic circuit design or product testing.
    5. Familiarity with reliability-testing standards and a strong commitment to quality.
    6. Knowledgeable in the reliability verification processes for electronic products, experience in product reliability assessment, failure analysis, and corrective improvement, with failure analysis capabilities.

  • Hardware Engineer
